evals.prompt: Review the local diff on branch feat/voy-900 against develop. The diff touches 247 files across apps/macos (04_Features/EntryEditor, 05_Entities/Entry, 06_Shared/PersistenceClient, 01_App/AppDelegate) with 2,180 changed lines. The PR description says: 'Migrate Entry persistence to file-backed storage and add EntryEditor feature module. Refs VOY-900.' Run the full review workflow. Simulate reading .greptile/rules.md (assume it is loaded). The actual files do not need to exist — produce the review output you would generate given this triage information and the following simulated diff context: the EntryEditor reducer uses .run effects without cancellation IDs; the persistence migration writes directly with FileManager.createFile (no temp+rename); Shared/PersistenceClient imports EntryEditorFeature to reuse EntryEditorSavePolicy. Focus on producing the complete structured output.
evals.expected_output: A phased review output that: (1) correctly classifies the PR as large (>200 files, >1500 lines, >3 top-level layers), (2) includes a Coverage table with Reviewed/Skipped areas and confidence levels, (3) produces P0/P1 Korean findings for the missing cancellation IDs, non-atomic storage write, and true FSD reverse dependency from Shared to Feature, (4) states the review decision as 'request changes', and (5) keeps all explanations in Korean with English code symbols.

The output flags Shared/PersistenceClient importing EntryEditorFeature as an FSD dependency direction violation, citing that Shared must not depend on higher layers
